title: The shiur player, a bar at the bottom with chapters, the talking head where the leader had it, open to anyone

tasks.title: The player bar, chapters, the pinned talking head, public reads and the keyboard

acs.text: WHILE a recording plays in the reader THE SYSTEM SHALL show a player bar docked at the bottom of the page (above the reader's own bottom chrome) with play or pause, the seek bar, a marker per chapter, back and forward 10 seconds, the speed, Hide video, the time and Close; the floating window keeps only the video

THE SYSTEM SHALL name each chapter marker by its ref (the Hebrew ref in a Hebrew interface) on hover and focus, go to the chapter on a click, and say which chapter is playing beside the time and in the seek bar's value text

WHILE the leader's camera was on THE SYSTEM SHALL show the video at the place the leader had their talking head, moving when they moved it; WHILE it was off, or the viewer pressed Hide video, it SHALL show no video window; an audio-only shiur SHALL show no video window and no Hide video
WHEN someone signed out opens a ready shiur's link and plays it THE SYSTEM SHALL load it through the public reads (spec 051); a signed-in viewer who is not in its room is answered the same way
WHILE the bar has focus THE SYSTEM SHALL play or pause on Space and move 5 seconds with the arrow keys, in the interface's reading direction
